meta.purpose: A decision queue, not a to-do list. Each row says what it changes, what it costs, what could go wrong, the evidence behind it, and which open question has to be answered first.
meta.how_to_use: Read the 'depends on' line before approving. Mark each row accept, hold or reject; the page stores the mark in your own browser and can copy the whole set as text. Nothing is transmitted.

suggestions.title: Tag every outbound product link with the Associates ID
suggestions.what: Rebuild each product URL as /dp/ASIN?tag=shopnow047c-20 instead of a bare product address.
suggestions.why: Program Policies 2(b) requires the Associates ID as a URL parameter on every link to an Amazon Site. The previous build linked to bare /dp/ addresses, so a click could not carry the ID in the URL.
suggestions.risk: Low: the destination ASIN is unchanged; only the parameter is added.
suggestions.depends_on: Q-07 (does the ID exist and is it active)

suggestions.title: Prove one click end to end before scaling anything
suggestions.what: Click one product link from the live site, then find that click in the Associates report and record the date.
suggestions.why: An untested affiliate link is a hypothesis. One click turns 'should earn' into 'earns' or into a fault worth chasing.
suggestions.risk: None; it is a read-only check.

suggestions.title: Correct the record on P-04 instead of leaving it unresolved
suggestions.what: Publish the ThermoMaven ASIN and title, and remove the stale 'unresolved' wording.
suggestions.why: The third request resolved. Leaving an out-of-date 'unknown' on the page would be as misleading as inventing an answer, so the record was corrected and the history kept in FLG-004.

suggestions.title: Add a second thermometer guide, because there are now two thermometers
suggestions.what: Publish a comparison-shaped guide for the two thermometers in the register, using only the sellers' stated features.
suggestions.why: Half the register is now thermometers. A publication whose only guides are about air fryers is not serving half its own catalogue, and the two products are different jobs: one instant read, one continuous monitoring.
suggestions.risk: Low. Claims stay inside the sellers' own wording.

suggestions.title: Group the guides into topic clusters instead of a flat list
suggestions.what: Four guides become three clusters (shape, size, upkeep) plus a thermometer cluster, with a hub page linking each.
suggestions.why: Internal links are the only ranking signal a static site controls completely, and flat lists share no authority.

suggestions.title: Deploy the collector so the five events have somewhere to land
suggestions.what: Run server/collect.js on a host the operator controls and set window.CC_ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT to its URL.
suggestions.why: The events are defined and instrumented but inert. GitHub Pages cannot run a collector, so this needs one decision: which host, and who owns the data.
suggestions.risk: Medium: needs a privacy notice and a retention rule before it goes live.
suggestions.recommendation: Approve the host, not the vendor

suggestions.title: Turn on Search Console and let 28 days answer the topic question
suggestions.what: Verify the property, submit sitemap.xml, then read the Queries report after four weeks.
suggestions.why: No keyword volume, difficulty or impression figure is on this site because none was available. Search Console is free and is the shortest path to real data.

suggestions.title: Ask five real readers what they nearly bought
suggestions.what: A five-question interview script, run by hand, recorded in the questions register.
suggestions.why: The site's guide topics are hypotheses. Five conversations would replace guesswork with at least a small amount of evidence, and cost nothing but time.
suggestions.risk: None. Do not publish quotes as endorsements without consent.

suggestions.title: Put the compliance gate in the publishing path, not in a document
suggestions.what: Make tools/check.py the gate: disclosure placement, sponsored rel, no price claims, no test claims, links resolve.
suggestions.why: A checklist in a markdown file is a promise. A check that fails the build is a gate.

suggestions.title: Add an email capture only when there is something to send
suggestions.what: RSS exists today; a newsletter needs a provider, a privacy notice and a publishing cadence.
suggestions.why: A capture box with no cadence collects addresses and disappoints them.
suggestions.risk: Medium: an email list is personal data and needs a lawful basis.

suggestions.title: Stop commissioning AI-written guides until one of them can be tested or measured
suggestions.what: No new guide topics until either Search Console data or a hands-on test exists.
suggestions.why: More synthetic prose makes the site bigger, not better. The current guides are defensible because they claim little; that advantage survives only by not diluting it.

suggestions.title: Put a real name and a two-line biography on the byline
suggestions.what: Replace the organisation byline with a person, once there is a person.
suggestions.why: A publication has an author. Inventing one would be worse than having none, so the field stays empty until you supply it.

suggestions.title: Keep the two ASIN fields apart, forever
suggestions.what: intended_asin and observed_asin are separate fields with a build check that they never merge.
suggestions.why: An observed redirect is evidence of where a link goes. It is not evidence of what the owner meant to ship, and merging the two would quietly destroy the distinction.

suggestions.title: Retire the duplicate edition by noindex, not by deletion
suggestions.what: Mark the superseded pages noindex and keep them out of the sitemap.
suggestions.why: Deleting another session's work is destructive; leaving two versions of the same five products competing in search is worse for the reader. noindex is reversible.

suggestions.title: Ask Amazon support three questions in writing
suggestions.what: Ask whether link.amazon short links are Special Links, what a valid tag parameter looks like on a /dp/ URL, and whether the supplied ID is active.
suggestions.why: These are the three things no page in this repository can settle, and all three are answerable by the party that owns the program.
